revocation: only the jobs whose own (scope,name) moved become cancel-requested; neighbours (same scope other name, other scope) are untouched
revocation→recovery: the returned Definition admits under the NEW identity and settles; the old job stays pinned to the execution-time identity
lease: every lease settles while ACTIVE; drain at self-counted zero reaches RELEASED
lease mutex: while A holds the jobId, B’s admission is refused (owner-mismatch); after drain, NEW admissions are refused from the first instant
